children: Calm, modern care for the pets you love
A fear-free, whole-pet practice for dogs and cats — preventive medicine, nutrition and gentle, unhurried visits that leave everyone a little calmer.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Certified fear-free handling, soft rooms and treats first. We work at your pet’s pace so a visit feels like a check-in, not a fight.
We treat the whole animal — conventional medicine paired with nutrition and supportive care, aimed at keeping pets well, not just fixing what’s broken.
No packed waiting room, no rushing you out the door. Real time with your vet to talk through what your pet actually needs.
Wellness plans that spread care across the year, plus video visits for the small questions — so help is there without the stressful trip.

children: The whole pet, at their pace

Fauna was built around one idea: a calmer visit is a better visit. Our team is fear-free certified, which means treats before needles, quiet rooms, and never forcing an anxious animal through something they’re not ready for.
It’s a whole-pet way of working — we look at nutrition, comfort and behaviour alongside the medicine, because the goal isn’t just treating illness. It’s helping your dog or cat thrive for years.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Fauna Veterinary is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, sunlit veterinary studio with a relaxed dog resting on a soft mat

children: We opened Fauna to practice the kind of medicine we always wanted for our own animals — calm, thorough, and centred on the whole pet rather than a single problem.

That means fear-free handling as the default, real time in every appointment, and honest guidance on food, prevention and comfort. Fewer stressed visits, healthier pets, and owners who actually understand the plan.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every visit is paced for your pet — treats, patience and gentle handling, never a wrestling match.
Wellness plans, nutrition and early screening keep problems small, so care costs less and pets feel better.
You’ll always leave knowing what we found, what it means, and what it costs — no jargon, no pressure.
